tokens.name: neutral-0
tokens.usage: Ramp step 0. The ground. Same value as `bg-base`.

tokens.name: neutral-1
tokens.usage: Ramp step 1. One step toward ink. Dark: same value as `bg-surface`.

tokens.name: neutral-2
tokens.usage: Ramp step 2. Idle marks, empty workspace dots, track backgrounds that must be solid.

tokens.name: neutral-3
tokens.usage: Ramp step 3. Solid hairline where an alpha one cannot be used.

tokens.name: neutral-4
tokens.usage: Ramp step 4. Solid quiet border.

tokens.name: neutral-5
tokens.usage: Ramp step 5. Solid default border, occupied marks.

tokens.name: neutral-6
tokens.usage: Ramp step 6. Light: the 3:1 control edge (`border-strong`).

tokens.name: neutral-7
tokens.usage: Ramp step 7. Dark: the 3:1 control edge (`border-strong`). Light: `text-subtle`.

tokens.name: neutral-8
tokens.usage: Ramp step 8. `text-secondary`.

tokens.name: neutral-9
tokens.usage: Ramp step 9. `text-primary`.

tokens.name: neutral-10

tokens.name: neutral-11
tokens.usage: Ramp step 11. `text-max`, and the focus ring.

tokens.name: bg-well
tokens.usage: The big typing surfaces that are a component of their own: the command palette prompt, the chat composer. The far end of the ramp (black in dark, white in light).

tokens.name: bg-field
tokens.usage: Fields inside a page or card: text fields, selects, tag input, input bar, table cells, checkboxes, switches. A breath above the layer it sits on, so it never punches a hole while you type; the `border-strong` edge says where to type.

tokens.name: bg-base
tokens.usage: Layer 0, the ground. The page and every layout tile: shell, sidebar, app bar, right and bottom bars.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Layer 1. A component that holds content: card, table, accordion, the active pane.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Layer 2, floats over the page: menus, toasts, tooltips, popovers. One step lighter than a surface, plus `shadow-raised`.

tokens.name: bg-overlay
tokens.usage: Layer 3, blocks the page: dialogs, sheets, the command palette. The lightest layer, on the scrim, plus `shadow-overlay`.

tokens.name: bg-inset
tokens.usage: Recessed areas inside a component: code wells, idle tracks. Behind the ground it sits on.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: State tint over any layer: hover, the current nav row.

tokens.name: bg-press
tokens.usage: State tint over any layer: pressed.

tokens.name: bg-fill
tokens.usage: Small fills over any layer: tracks, count badges, keys, the segmented track, skeletons.

tokens.name: bg-control
tokens.usage: Resting fill of a secondary button.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows and sections inside one component. Decoration only: never the only sign that something is a control.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: The edge of a container: card, table, menu, dialog, layout tile. Visible on every layer.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: The edge of anything you operate: fields, checkboxes, radios, switches, slider tracks. 3:1 or more on every layer (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring: 2px, 2px out, max ink. Never a brand colour, so it shows on a primary button and on every accent.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: separators, marks, quiet labels. 4.5:1 on every layer.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text, timestamps, hints, placeholders. 4.5:1 on every layer.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Default text on every layer.

tokens.name: text-strong
tokens.usage: Headings, emphasised body, input values, menu rows.

tokens.name: text-max
tokens.usage: Reserved: the current nav item, the selected tab or row. Never nominal status.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls only, always with a reason close by (see Disabled). Exempt from AA; never informational text.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs, sheets and the command palette.

tokens.name: selection
